_readme: Config for the 'Full Practice Exam' mode in alt-quiz.html. Each bank has a nominal share (0-100 scale) of the exam; at render/allocation time these are normalized across all currently-active banks so the *displayed* percentages always add up to exactly 100 -- that's what lets a brand new bank drop in at 'defaultPercent' and get folded into the mix without you having to re-balance every other number in this file by hand. Raise a bank's nominal share to make it show up more often on the practice exam relative to the others; lower it (or set it to 0) to make it show up less often or not at all. Bank keys must match the 'key' field used in ALT_QUIZ_CHAPTERS inside alt-quiz.html. Any bank in ALT_QUIZ_CHAPTERS that is NOT listed in 'percentages' below automatically falls back to 'defaultPercent', so newly-added banks are included at an equal share without needing to edit this file -- add an explicit entry here only when you want a bank's share to differ from the default. Visitors can also pin exact percentages per bank from the Full Practice Exam setup screen (browser-local, saved to localStorage) -- pinning one bank rescales the rest proportionally so the on-screen percentages still sum to 100. If the weighted total exceeds how many questions actually exist across all banks, the exam just uses everything available and runs short of totalQuestions.
